description: Create a custom source tag with a name, URL patterns and optionally an icon and colour. Read the tag listing first: built-in tags already cover media, social, government, e-commerce, review sites, PR wires, academic and wiki sources, and a host they miss is better added to the built-in tag than given a new one. Obtain user confirmation before calling. MCP executes immediately after authorization; Athena AI chat presents an approval card. Patterns support hosts (example.com), subtrees (*.example.com), path sections (example.com/blog), exact pages (example.com/blog$) and query constraints. Up to 500 patterns. These are source tags, not prompt tags.

color.description: Optional colour family: ochre, clay, brick, amber, olive, moss, teal, slate, ink, mauve or plum. Default ink.

icon.description: Optional icon key from the curated set (for example newspaper, capsule, hospital, graduation-cap, building). Omit for a letter badge.

name.description: Custom tag name. Names of built-in tags (Media, Social, Government, …) and of Owned and Competitor are reserved.

items.description: Host (example.com), subtree (*.example.com), path section (example.com/blog), exact page (example.com/blog$) or query constraint (youtube.com/watch?v=abc).

name: source_tags__create
